name: fillet_finds_the_renumbered_edge_again
why: ENTRY E19. A plan written by looking at the state ONCE: «two holes, then fillet the front-right corner». The uids of the edges are positional, ordered by length: the two O12 holes add four circumferences of 37.7, longer than the four edges of 20, and the fillet — which carries the uid read BEFORE the holes — now names a circumference. Up to library 0.119.0 an edge whose uid had changed was simply refused (see the twin case); for faces the search by signature had been there since 10/9 (entry E6), for edges it had not. `uid_from_step: 2` does what the bridge does: uid and signatures from the state BEFORE the holes.
_why_two_holes: With four circumferences of 37.7 the four old places of the edges of 20 (E9-E12) all end up on a circumference: the swap does not depend on the order among equal lengths. And the expectation on `measurements.reanchors` says whether the finding really took place.
_what_it_found_written_down: With library 0.119.0 this case PASSED without finding anything, and not by luck: `LunghezzaMm` measured the chord between the endpoints, and the border of a hole — a closed edge — was «0 long». The holes ended up at the bottom of the ranking and never renumbered anything (bench probe `prova0089 rinumera`: E13-E16 «0 long»). Repaired in 0.120.0 with the true length: now E11 becomes E15, and the answer says so.
defect_caught: Two, opposite ones. The refusal of legitimate work (the old behaviour). And success on the WRONG edge: the volume is the same on all four edges of 20, and only the centroid says which corner was rounded.

expect.tolerance_why: 120000 minus pi*6^2*20 = 2261.947: the twentieth covers the rounding
the second hole equal to the first: another 2261.947
115476.107 minus (1 - pi/4) x 8^2 x 20 = 274.690: the calculation has pi inside

computed by hand: the two holes are symmetric, and the cut-out of the fillet has its centroid at R(5/6 - pi/4)/(1 - pi/4) = 1.787 from the corner, that is at (48.213; 28.213; 10). On the corner at x = -50 the centroid would go to x = +0.115: the sign says which edge
